purpose: Measure QKV components after establishing learnable retrieval and binding-sensitive controls on Mac
preflight: AdamW seed 401 on main 039964e, 1200 updates, 4 pairs, no gap: validation accuracy reached 100 percent by update 400; kept separately as an exploratory receipt

development.selection: lowest final validation CE within each family; all Tiger ablations share selected full-Tiger LR
development.qualification: selected recipe must reach at least 90 percent validation and rebound accuracy, and at most 20 percent old-target accuracy after rebinding; test data is absent

secondary_metrics: validation CE averaged over sampled updates
first sampled update at 90 percent validation accuracy
confirmation.controls: same model initialization, examples, batch order, clipping, warmup/cosine LR factors and other Tiger settings per paired seed

binding_check: rotate memory values while retaining keys, queries and the value bag; evaluate both new correct targets and obsolete original targets
interpretation: component effects on this short synthetic task; three seeds do not establish general optimizer superiority or LoRA benefits
timing: diagnostic only; local host load is uncontrolled
